column1: Bobby Witt Jr. leads the slate with a strong hit probability and recent uptick in production, making him a reliable option against Blake Snell, especially with the platoon advantage. Jeremy Pena offers similar appeal atop the lineup, showing steady season-long contact and a favorable matchup. Ernie Clement and Luis Arraez are also in play, each benefiting from a solid park factor and consistent hit rates. Prioritize Witt for his combination of consistency and matchup edge.
